items.reason: The new fetch in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8-14 has no abort signal or application timeout. Zoom awaits this refresh at packages/app-store/zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:79 and awaits authentication before API requests at :237, so a stalled sync endpoint blocks dependent operations without an application-controlled deadline.

The truthiness check at packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:5 would exclude zero, but callers pass persisted credential.userId values (packages/app-store/zoomvideo/lib/VideoApiAdapter.ts:93). These reference User.id, which uses autoincrement (packages/prisma/schema.prisma:132-133,177), and signup leaves ID generation to the database (apps/web/pages/api/auth/signup.ts:197-202); the numeric type alone does not establish a reachable zero-ID case.
